prompt: Benny plants a garden behind the school
title: School Garden Grow
irony: Benny plants seeds to share, yet Vera stores seeds safe indoors where safe seeds sleep unsprouted, till she risks dirt and the shared patch feeds the street.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Benny touches seed packets on Vera's kitchen table while Teddy sniffs damp soil in cups.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Benny begs Vera to plant tomatoes behind the school fence while Vera charts sun and Teddy names sprout facts.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox bursts in daring Benny to plant candy for giant vines before Vera finishes measuring rain.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Benny lifts empty patch behind school fence chanting with friends while Knox points and Vera grips charts.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Benny buries candy and pours juice while Teddy shouts seed facts and Knox cheers louder.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Soggy candy mold smears mud while Knox slips laughing and Benny stares at bare dirt crying.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Benny kicks bare dirt behind school fence chanting with friends while Vera watches clutching packets.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Vera kneels alone in dirt confessing fear to Teddy while dusk cools empty rows.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Vera tears packets open scattering seeds with Teddy and pats soil gently smiling.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Benny dances round fresh rows chanting with friends while Vera pats dirt singing beside Knox.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Benny touches empty seed packets beside thriving school rows sharing tomatoes while Knox munches, Teddy grins, Vera claps.
